decisions.decision: POST /ui/theme/switch REQUIRES CSRF (Supercharger pattern), not the language switch's no-CSRF exception
decisions.why: LangSwitcher earned the exception by mounting on every page; ThemeSwitcher mounts on one authenticated page, so minting a token is cheap.

decisions.decision: The theme cookie stays but is a READ path only; the write is authenticated-only, so no anonymous POST path exists
decisions.why: Its only job is post-logout continuity — home and login still render the chosen theme.

decisions.decision: ThemeSwitcher mounts only on /settings (not the navbar), and /settings renders the theme control only
decisions.why: Roadmap tier-2 scope column and the ticket title; the owner's standing preference is minimal scope.
Artifact authoring against a fully-decided roadmap; no cross-cutting ambiguity that needed Opus.
